title: HUMINT Report: Advance Warning of Targeted Intrusion Campaign
subject: Targeted cyber intrusion against defence contractor network — imminent threat
body: A reliable source with direct access reported that a nation-state affiliated threat group known as APT-X is planning a targeted spearphishing campaign against defence contractors in the region, expected to commence within 24-48 hours. The group is known to use encoded PowerShell payloads delivered via weaponised Office documents. Target IP ranges include the 10.0.0.0/16 subnet. C2 infrastructure has been established at 203.0.113.45 and the domain c2.phantom-op.xyz. The campaign, designated OP-PHANTOM-2024, focuses on credential harvesting and intellectual property exfiltration. Indicators: IP 203.0.113.45, hash 92a4ccf36f4d0b44e58d2c0c4e5b1234, domain c2.phantom-op.xyz.

title: OSINT: C2 Infrastructure Analysis — APT-X Campaign
body: Open source analysis of IP 203.0.113.45 identifies it as associated with APT-X infrastructure based on certificate reuse, hosting patterns, and passive DNS analysis. The domain c2.phantom-op.xyz was registered on 2024-01-12 via a privacy-protected registrar. The ASN hosting this IP has previously hosted APT-X C2 nodes. Recommend blocking at perimeter immediately.
